thesis_triggers.event: About -27% from $341, just above the $243 52-week low and ~26x FY27 consensus EPS of ~$9.58. With the Fed projecting a peak near 4.10% and a flat 2027 path, rate-driven de-rating to ~28-29x on intact ~$10 NTM EPS reaches roughly $280-290 without breaking the thesis. A close below ~$248 would mean earnings estimates are being cut. Likely causes: gross margin guided well below 46% as ~$2.00/Gb DRAM outruns price increases, iPhone 18/Duo unit declines after the price hikes, a D.C. Circuit ruling that bans Google's distributor payments (~$20B/yr), or a punitive China semiconductor tariff rate on 2027-06-23.

supervisor_summary: After round 2 the five forecasters agree closely: fair value ~$312-320, median ~$333, P(close >= $341 on 2027-09-25) ~0.47, all driven by a 5%+ 10-year, 2027 memory costs locked ~33% higher, and only ~8% EPS growth against a ~35.6x multiple. My checks confirmed those facts and the tails (DOJ's payment-ban cross-appeal, the June 2027 China chip-tariff step-up). They also showed the Fed projecting a peak near 4.10% with no 2027 hikes, with the 5.17% yield already in the $341 price. I therefore nudge the center back up slightly: median ~$338, P(>=341) ~0.49, fair value $318, thesis break $248. This is a low-confidence adjustment, so the forecasters' mean remains a sound baseline.
key_drivers: Valuation vs rates: ~35.6x FY27 EPS for ~8% EPS growth (FY26 ~$8.86 to FY27 ~$9.58), with the 10-year at 5.17% (highest since 2007). The Fed SEP sees one more hike to ~4.10% and then a hold through 2027, with core PCE at 3.4%.
Memory costs: 2027 DRAM contracted at ~$2.00/Gb vs $1.50 (+33%), no relief before 2028. Margins (FQ4 guide 47-48% vs 50.1%) depend on price increases, not cost relief.

Product cycle: record close ~$344.70 (2026-09-22, $5T market cap) on iPhone 18 Pro lead times, the ~$1,999 Duo (Morgan Stanley: ~$14B December-quarter revenue) and Gemini-based Siri. FQ4 results ~2026-10-29.

Google payments: DOJ cross-appeal seeks a payment ban. Oral argument is unscheduled, Google's reply brief is due 2026-09-29, and a ruling is not expected before 2027. A low-probability, high-impact in-horizon tail.
China chip tariff: the Section 301 rate on Chinese legacy semiconductors steps up from 0% on 2027-06-23, with the rate announced at least 30 days before.
